next_steps.action: Disconnect power. Measure resistance from boost output to ground.

measure.where: Boost output diode cathode / output cap
measure.expected: >100 ohm typical for low-voltage boosts; backlight boosts at 30+ V can be >10 kohm.
measure.safety: Backlight boost outputs can carry residual charge at high voltage; discharge via a bleeder first.

interpretations.then: Short on boost output. Suspect output diode shorted, output cap shorted, or load (backlight string) shorted.
No short. Proceed to check input supply.
